slots.name: reservoir level
slots.sentence: Green, who started working on Lundy in 2004, said water shortages had become more frequent and they also considered shutting the island in September 2025 when reservoir levels hit 33%.

slots.name: percentage of expected rainfall
slots.sentence: He said there had been no significant rainfall since April and it had barely seen 20% of the typical 1.5m (4.92ft) rain it expected by this time of year.

slots.name: largest water delivery volume
slots.sentence: The first delivery to the island of about 67,000 litres had been the biggest and cost about £7,000, said Green.

slots.name: water restrictions status
slots.sentence: Water restrictions are also in place for residents and visitors.

slots.name: pond pumping status
slots.sentence: The island, which is managed by the Landmark Trust, is now pumping water from ponds used by wildlife to a treatment works as a "last resort".
